scope: All non-API filesystem screen templates under pages and app. Dynamic route instances are intentionally not enumerated. Static files, router shells and rewrite/redirect aliases are listed separately. Source review only, not a fresh visual or security audit. Baseline records remain in routes; six in-progress revamp templates are in added_routes. current_summary combines both without counting four statically generated content URLs as four templates.
marketing_absence_note: Only / is a checked-in marketing screen. Some legal/help destinations are external/configured; absence is scope to resolve, not proof every page is required. Homepage product/how-it-works/FAQ are anchors, not separate routes.

native_mobile.evidence: One root Next.js package; no Expo/RN/Capacitor/Flutter config, iOS/Android source project, manifest/service worker found in tracked source scan.
